title: Skripty
description: Sync your Skripts directly to your server through Skripty.
body:
Create and edit your Skripts on the [Skripty website](https://skripty.dev/) and automatically sync and reload them in game to your Minecraft server with a click of a button and invite others to edit your Skripts without giving them access to your entire server.

## Installation Guide
Get a project id and key from the Skripty website under the sync tab and configure it in the config. You may configure multiple projects to different directories at once. After configuring, simply run `/skript reload` to reload the config.
```yml
api-url: "https://api.skripty.dev"
sync-projects:
  - project-id: ""
    project-key: ""
    sync-directory: "plugins/Skript/scripts/skripty"
auto-reload-scripts: true
reconnect-seconds: 5
```

## How to Report Issues
